results.excerpt: Run ar1 (issue 29, told in the body not to call the return tool): every actor returned anyway and the item reached the ask. Run ar2 (issue 31, stronger instruction in body and Expect): the brief agent ended with the SubagentHandback tool, not the return tool. The real SubagentStop hook ran and its block was recorded as a hook_blocking_error in the agent's log, but the agent had already ended, took no further turn, and no second SubagentStop came (1 SubagentStop row). So no failed.json, no no-return refusal row, and the item journal holds only xstate.init: the item stayed in briefing with ar2:0.brief open until the driver stopped, the same stall as run 2. Run ar3 (issue 32, told not to use SubagentHandback either) was refused by the auto-mode classifier on the driver's Agent call, so it never ran; not retried. The block-then-fail path is untested in the world for a plain final message; for SubagentHandback, which is how run 2 stalled, the block does not re-prompt the agent. Scratch issues 29, 31, 32 and PR 30 closed, nothing merged
